name: labgraph
description: LabScenario orchestrator: list/get/validate/plan/apply/reset/status across LabDNS, LabMITM, LabMail, LabLDAP control, and TacLab. Apply is sequential DNS→MITM→mail→LDAP→TacLab; partial failure is honest; omitted appliances are left alone. LabLDAP and TacLab have no native file-level apply.
